title: Canton Food Not Bombs first-party zine social identifiers
summary: Canton Food Not Bombs' first-party News Not Bombs publication identifies its Facebook and Instagram accounts as CantonFNB and links its current website/newsletter identity.

data.notes: First-party News Not Bombs publication lists Facebook:CantonFNB, Instagram:CantonFNB, website cantonfnb.com, and newsletter cantonfnb.substack.com. Current cantonfnb.com remains active in September 2026.
